# VD-08 Screws, threaded inserts, spacers and standoffs

This page is an excerpt of data that the vendors themselves publish (product pages, datasheets, drawings): standard
sizes of socket head cap screws and set screws, and vendors' ranges of heat-set threaded inserts, spacers and
standoffs. The values are the vendors' own, in the vendors' units; nothing is converted. "not published" marks a value
that the vendor pages used for this excerpt do not state. The page sets comparable parts side by side; it does not say
which of them, if any, is on the robot.
